name: Compute Cluster S68: ML Classification Pipeline
description: Tests: tuple_pack, ml_robust(window_size, step), lightgbm_classifier(num_estimators, learning_rate, num_leaves, min_data_in_leaf, window_size, step). Walk-forward ML prediction.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S68: ML Classification Pipeline
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === FEATURES ===
feat_mom = returns(period=21)(close)
feat_vol = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)
feat_rsi = rsi(close, 14)
# === TARGET: next day up/down ===
next_ret = returns(close) << 1
target = next_ret > 0

# === CLASSIFIER (pass individual feature series, NOT tuple_pack) ===
model = lightgbm_classifier(
    num_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target)

pred = model.prediction
prob = model.probability

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='LightGBM Probability of Up Day',
    category='ML',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='P(up)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=prob)

xy_lines(
    title='Features: Momentum & Vol',
    category='Features',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='21d Momentum', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='21d Vol', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(feat_mom, feat_vol))
